name: 유아이볼 (uibowl)
description:
Uibowl is a design reference database of real UI/UX screens collected from mobile apps, websites, and games. With this connector, you can search Uibowl directly from within Claude to find specific screen types, on-screen copy, or UI components, and pull up real screenshots along with links back to the original source.

Key features include pattern search across flows like login, onboarding, checkout, and sign-up; OCR text search to find screens containing specific copy; component search for concrete UI elements such as buttons, cards, and bottom sheets; app-specific filtering to browse all screens from a particular app or service; MAU lookup to check an app's monthly active users; and real-time popularity rankings across apps and products.

This connector is especially useful for product managers and designers who want to quickly benchmark how competitors and similar services implement a given flow or screen, teams comparing how the same UI pattern is handled across different products, and content or UX writers looking for real-world microcopy references.

The connector is read-only: it only performs searches and does not access Claude's conversation history, memory, or user-uploaded files. Every result includes real screenshots from the source app and a link back to the corresponding screen on Uibowl.

_published_faq.name: How do I add 유아이볼 (uibowl) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 유아이볼 (uibowl) to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://uibowl.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the 유아이볼 (uibowl) MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: 유아이볼 (uibowl) provides these MCP tools: filter_by_app, get_app_mau_info, get_popular_rankings, search_by_ocr_text, search_components, and search_ui_patterns.
